bundle.shortDescription: A desktop app for managing deep work sessions
bundle.longDescription: Deep Work is a desktop app for planning distraction-free work days: a proportional block timeline, pomodoro timer with a full-session focus mode, day templates, an archive of what actually landed, and a local sound library.
